compose_config:
name: rungrid
services:
  minio:
    command:
      - server
      - /data
      - --console-address
      - :9001
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: rungrid-secret
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: rungrid
    image: quay.io/minio/minio:RELEASE.2025-04-22T22-12-26Z
    networks:
      default: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        host_ip: 127.0.0.1
        target: 9000
        published: "9000"
        protocol: tcp
      - mode: ingress
        host_ip: 127.0.0.1
        target: 9001
        published: "9001"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: artifacts
        target: /data
        volume: {}
  minio-init:
    command:
      - until mc alias set local http://minio:9000 rungrid rungrid-secret; do sleep
        1; done; mc mb --ignore-existing local/rungrid
    depends_on:
      minio:
        condition: service_started
        required: true
    entrypoint:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
    image: quay.io/minio/mc:RELEASE.2025-04-16T18-13-26Z
    networks:
      default: null
  otel:
    command:
      - --config=/etc/otel/config.yml
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector:0.127.0
    networks:
      default: null
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /Users/zubairqazi/Documents/rungrid/deploy/otel.yml
        target: /etc/otel/config.yml
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
  postgres:
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: rungrid
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: rungrid
      POSTGRES_USER: rungrid
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - pg_isready -U rungrid
      timeout: 2s
      interval: 2s
      retries: 30
    image: postgres:17.5-bookworm
    networks:
      default: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        host_ip: 127.0.0.1
        target: 5432
        published: "55432"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: postgres
        target: /var/lib/postgresql/data
        volume: {}
  prometheus:
    depends_on:
      server:
        condition: service_started
        required: true
    image: prom/prometheus:v3.4.0
    networks:
      default: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        host_ip: 127.0.0.1
        target: 9090
        published: "9091"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /Users/zubairqazi/Documents/rungrid/deploy/prometheus.yml
        target: /etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
  server:
    build:
      context: /Users/zubairqazi/Documents/rungrid
      dockerfile: deploy/Dockerfile.server
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://rungrid:rungrid@postgres:5432/rungrid?sslmode=disable
      OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT: http://otel:4318
      RUNGRID_GRPC_ADDR: 0.0.0.0:9090
      RUNGRID_HTTP_ADDR: 0.0.0.0:8080
      RUNGRID_LEASE_SECONDS: "15"
    networks:
      default: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        host_ip: 127.0.0.1
        target: 8080
        published: "8080"
        protocol: tcp
      - mode: ingress
        host_ip: 127.0.0.1
        target: 9090
        published: "9090"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
  worker:
    build:
      context: /Users/zubairqazi/Documents/rungrid
      dockerfile: deploy/Dockerfile.worker
    depends_on:
      minio-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: true
      server:
        condition: service_started
        required: true
    environment:
      AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: rungrid
      AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-east-1
      AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: rungrid-secret
      RUNGRID_CPU: "2"
      RUNGRID_GRPC_ADDR: server:9090
      RUNGRID_MEMORY_MB: "4096"
      RUNGRID_S3_BUCKET: rungrid
      RUNGRID_S3_ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000
    networks:
      default: null
    stop_grace_period: 1m0s
networks:
  default:
    name: rungrid_default
volumes:
  artifacts:
    name: rungrid_artifacts
  postgres:
    name: rungrid_postgres
